title: Access switch (admin)
description: Admin only: PUT /api/pairing/clients/{client_id}/access-switch. Turns the device's access switch on or off (the same switch Home Assistant shows as switch.<ns>_<name>_access). 409 no_access_switch when the device has none (no access hours and not of kind guest, house_sitter or babysitter). Answer: rest/paired-client.json with access_now.
